reviewed_by: Claude: Butler mode hide columns, jump to latest, bulk thread removal
reason: ButlerModePage gains thread-bar toggles that hide the threads list and the board (device-local, nebula.butler-mode.hidden-panels), a Jump to latest button on the thread log, and checkboxes in the threads list for bulk Archive/Delete (Delete confirms; one Core request per thread through the same helper as the single-thread actions, so UI API call signatures are unchanged). useButlerColumns reads the rail width from the rail divider so a hidden rail no longer skews the thread divider. Frontend selects the column hook test and both Butler mode page suites; Playwright runs the real-Core butler-mode journey, which now hides both columns, reloads, checks Jump to latest, brings the board back through Oversight, and bulk-archives two threads after cancelling a bulk delete, at desktop, 1024px and 320px.
exclusions: No Python, native or Core change. Layout preferences and bulk actions over existing Core routes are not settings, so the settings catalog, settings-assistant doc and product knowledge index are unchanged; the Butler workflow registry still reports the same 3 pre-existing unreviewed signatures. Other phone widths are not selected; the bulk list is the same component at every width.
